evaluation_protocol.task: 2-Way Few-Shot Classification (1 unseen held-out + 1 sampled known breed)
evaluation_protocol.label_mapping: 0 = Unseen Held-out Class, 1 = Sampled Known Class
evaluation_protocol.f1_type: Macro-averaged F1 (unweighted mean of per-class F1)
evaluation_protocol.leakage_prevention: Group-level disjointness enforced at episode construction: base images and their _c counterparts share a sample-group ID and are never split across support and query sets.
